mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a temperature of 77 degrees under overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase.

Important city updates include the Labor Day holiday schedule, where city facilities and the drop-off site will be closed on Monday, September 7, though the brush site remains open. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center is updating its flooring, resulting in limited programming through September 9.

There is plenty to do around town, with trivia happening today at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Looking toward tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, or Wednesday night trivia.
In a noteworthy call from August 25, Verona police officers successfully utilized an AED to revive a 68-year-old man who was pulseless and not breathing during a medical emergency.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
